expressions.title: The Royal Pakistan Air Force (Extension of Service) Act, 1952
expressions.title_basis: p1 blocks 2349504-2349505 print 'ACT No. XLVI OF 1952 / An Act to provide for the retention in service of certain persons enrolled for service in the Royal Pakistan Air Force'; s.1(1) (block 2349508) names it the Royal Pakistan Air Force (Extension of Service) Act, 1952; it ends on p2 at s.3 (blocks 2349521-2349522). Its first span (blocks 2349488-2349493) holds its own long-title line, margin notes and proviso sliver that the extractor read before ACT No. XLV's body. ACT No. XLV OF 1952 (blocks 2349477-2349487, 2349494-2349503: the Air Force Validation of Discharges Act, 1952) is the law of document 8028, released there from the same Gazette page -- set aside as apparatus here (owner policy q1 'split').
